description: Given a GHS pictogram code (GHS01 to GHS09) or its name (for example "flame over circle", "skull and crossbones"), returns what it means, the hazard classes it covers as listed on OSHA's pictogram QuickCard (OSHA 3491, 2024), whether OSHA's Hazard Communication Standard requires it, and SDSentry's guide page for it. Read-only, free.
name: ghs_pictogram
title: Explain a GHS hazard pictogram
